invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破74000（基于ATR 512和-2.8%风险），或融资费率Z-score升至>80%（多头拥挤），或日线趋势转熊（价格<SMA50 $70157）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below 74000 (based on ATR 512 and -2.8% risk), or funding Z-score rises to >80% (long crowded), or daily trend turns bearish (price < SMA50 $70157).

invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格突破2450（基于ATR 21和+3.9%风险），或融资费率Z-score降至<50%（多头压力缓解），或日线趋势转熊（价格<SMA50 $2133）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks above 2450 (based on ATR 21 and +3.9% risk), or funding Z-score falls to <50% (long pressure eases), or daily trend turns bearish (price < SMA50 $2133).
